$comment: Type-check-only config for the lambda/ handlers, which the main tsconfig.json excludes (they're esbuild-bundled, not tsc-compiled). Uses bundler resolution so extensionless imports and the drizzle-orm/aws-data-api/pg subpath resolve the same way esbuild sees them. No emit — this is purely `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.lambda.json` for verification.
